## Biographical Information

(b. Otterbourne 1876)

schoolmistress

She was the daughter of [George](person_357.qmd) and Emma Collins.  Her mother was the postmistress in Otterbourne in 1891.  She had a number of much older half-brothers and half-sisters to whom CMY frequently refers.
